# Open Library fixtures

`search-piranesi.json` is a live response from
`GET https://openlibrary.org/search.json?q=Piranesi&limit=5`, captured on 2026-11-07 with the
Loregalia User-Agent. Tests use it to check mapping and never call the network.

The data is from [Open Library](https://openlibrary.org/developers/api).
